field_text_formatted.value: Update, August 2026: I built it. That experiment with Consumers and theme settings became the Decoupled Settings module, and it does what this post said the JSON:API couldn't: exposes Drupal's own site configuration, with per-consumer overrides. Config Pages is still what I reach for when a site needs settings it invents for itself, which is what this post was really about. For the settings Drupal already stores, see Drupal site settings over JSON:API, per consumer.
